{{Quote|I boarded my shuttle, ordering Captain Karm to take me up to the Lindworm, where I could assume command|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Karm''' was an individual who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], Karm acted as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] and was stationed in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Livien Magnus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] during a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Battle of Ord Radama|attack]] on the world. During the latter stages of the battle, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] attacked Malgus' [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Ord Radama and Malgus ordered Karm to fly him from Livien Magnus to the Sith [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] ''[[Lindworm]]''. Karm flew the shuttle with skill and evaded the Republic's [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]], and the Captain landed Malgus' shuttle in the ''Lindworm''{{'s}} ventral [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In an impenetrable Easter Egg that pleased only me, the pilot of Malgus' shuttle taking him to the Lindworm is "Captain Karm." One of my favorite books as a kid was an English-translated version of Swedish author Astrid Lindgren's The Brothers Lionheart, which featured a giant lindworm named Karm fighting a giant dragon named Katla.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 2)}}</ref>}}
Karm was created by [[Daniel Wallace]] and was mentioned in the [[2012]] publication ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''. Wallace intended Karm to be a reference to the 1973 fantasy novel [[Wikipedia:The Brothers Lionheart|''The Brothers Lionheart'']] by the [[Wikipedia:Sweden|Swedish]] writer [[Wikipedia:Astrid Lindgren|Astrid Lindgren]], one of Wallace's favorite books from his childhood, which featured a giant [[Wikipedia:Lindworm|lindworm]] character called Karm.<ref name="Book of Sith endnotes" />
